jp: {voice:00DC01}桟道を歩き始めて三日目。{n}谷底の深さにも、{n}すっかり慣れちゃったよね。
en: Day three on this cliff road. I've gotten totally used to how deep the gorge is.

jp: {voice:00DD01}要は気持ちの問題。{n}崖の下を見るからいけないのよ。
en: It's all in your head. The trick is not looking down the cliff.

jp: {voice:00DE01}ココは高くない…、{n}だから恐くない…、って感じ。
en: It's not high up here... so it's not scary... like that.

jp: {voice:00DF01}本に書いてあったけど、{n}口数が多いのは{n}緊張してる証拠だって。
en: I read in a book that talking a lot is a sign you're nervous.

jp: {voice:00E001}なるほどな。
en: Makes sense.

jp: {voice:00E101}なによ、ジェノン！{n}余計なことを言わないでよね！
en: Hey, Jenon! Keep your comments to yourself!

jp: {voice:00E201}あ、図星だったってこと？
en: Oh, did I hit the mark?

jp: {voice:00E301}……賑やかだな、しかし。
en: ...Lively bunch, I must say.

jp: {voice:00E401}ちょっと黙らせます？
en: Shall I shut them up a little?

jp: {voice:00E501}いや、構わん。{n}働きどころで力を出して貰えれば{n}それでいい。
en: No, leave them. So long as they show their strength when there is work to be done, that is enough.

jp: {voice:00E601}みんな、黙って！
en: Everyone, quiet!

jp: {voice:00E701}構わんと言っただろ。
en: I said to leave them.

jp: {voice:00E801}違います、{n}方伯の言う働きどころですよ。
en: That's not it. This is the work you were talking about, Margrave.

jp: {voice:00E901}ガーロット、荒い足音！{n}賊よ！
en: Garlot, rough footsteps! Bandits!

jp: {voice:00EA01}なんだなんだ？{n}姉ちゃん達、えらく物騒なエモノ{n}持ってんなぁ。
en: What's all this? You girls are carrying some mighty dangerous toys.

jp: {voice:00EB01}もしかして、アレか？{n}用心棒とか言うヤツ？
en: Maybe you're one of them, whaddaya call 'em? Bodyguards?

jp: {voice:00EC01}へっへっへっ、{n}命が惜しけりゃ、やめときな。{n}荷物を置いて、去った方がいい。
en: Heh heh heh, if you value your lives, don't try it. Better to leave your stuff and walk away.

jp: {voice:00ED01}ガーロット、わかるか？
en: Garlot, do you see?

jp: {voice:00EE01}ん…？　何がだ？
en: Hm...? See what?

jp: {voice:00EF01}今の帝国には、こんなクズ共が{n}溢れかえっているのだ。
en: The Empire today is overflowing with trash such as this.

jp: {voice:00F001}どうしようもねぇな……
en: They're hopeless...

jp: {voice:00F101}グラムブレイズ、前へ！{n}山賊共に、今までの報いを{n}存分に受けさせよ！
en: Gram Blaze, forward! See that these bandits are paid in full for all they have done!

jp: {voice:00F201}だけど、参ったね……{n}戦うにはちょっと窮屈過ぎる。
en: Still, this is a pain... It's a little too cramped for a fight.

jp: {voice:00F301}地形が狭い場合は、{n}どうユニオンを結成するか、{n}十分考えて行動しなきゃね。
en: When the ground is this narrow, we'll have to think hard about how we form our Unions.

jp: {voice:00F401}そ、そんな……
en: N-no way...

jp: {voice:00F501}大した事は無かったな。{n}正直、拍子抜けだぜ。
en: That was nothing. Honestly, what a letdown.

jp: {voice:00F601}山賊相手にいい勝負をされたら{n}お前達を雇った意味がない。
en: If bandits could give you a good fight, there would be no point in having hired you.

jp: {voice:00F701}待って、ガーロット！{n}まだ敵の気配、消えてないって。
en: Wait, Garlot! I can still sense enemies out there.

jp: {voice:00F801}見つけたよッ！{n}ガーロットとその仲間ども！
en: Found you! Garlot and friends!

jp: {voice:00F901}今日のセリカは準備万端！{n}さぁ、死んで貰うんだから②
en: Cerica's all ready today! Now, time for you to die!

jp: {voice:00FA01}また来たの、あの女……
en: Her again...

jp: タダの用心棒にしてはやるな！{n}何者だ、お前ら？
en: You're pretty good for mere bodyguards! Who are you people?

jp: 俺達は、グラム・ブレイズ。{n}ヴェルマン方伯の私兵団だ！{n}この名、胸に刻んで地獄へ行け！
en: We're Gram Blaze, Margrave Velleman's private army! Carve that name in your heart and go to hell!

jp: 侮るな！{n}こいつ、手ごわいぞ。
en: Don't underestimate him! This one's tough.

jp: 女だからって甘く見ないでよね！
en: Don't go easy on me just because I'm a girl!

jp: 優男の分際でッ！
en: You pretty boy!

jp: 見た目で実力を計る事ほど{n}愚かな事はないっ！
en: Nothing is more foolish than judging strength by looks!

jp: 浅黒い肌に巨大な斧……{n}この女…、まさかメデューテ③
en: Dark skin, a huge axe... This woman... She couldn't be Medoute!?

jp: あたしを知ってるとはね。{n}嬉しくも、何ともないけど。
en: So you've heard of me. Not that I'm flattered in the least.

jp: くそっ！{n}詰めが甘かったか③
en: Damn it! Did I get careless at the end!?

jp: とんでもねぇプレッシャーだ。{n}お前ら、油断するんじゃないぞ！
en: The pressure's unreal. Don't let your guard down, you lot!

jp: オラオラぁ！{n}盗賊だからって舐めんなよ②
en: C'mon, c'mon! Don't look down on us just 'cause we're bandits!

jp: 俺に戦いを挑むとは、{n}命が惜しくないようだな。
en: Challenging me? I guess you don't value your life.

jp: 調子に乗ってるね……
en: Getting cocky, aren't you...

jp: なんだ、拍子抜けだ。{n}噂ほどの実力は無いようだな。
en: Huh, what a letdown. Not as strong as the rumors say, it seems.

jp: 油断して、しまったか……
en: I got careless...

jp: 真っ黒い岩石だ、珍しいな…
en: A pitch-black rock. That's rare...

jp: 黒いと、硬くて強そうでいいな。{n}いただいておくか。
en: Black means hard and strong. Works for me. Guess I'll take it.

jp: 黒い色の鉱石ね。
en: A black-colored ore.

jp: 加工してもらったら{n}武器になるかもしれないわね。
en: If I have it worked, it might make a weapon.

jp: ここの岩肌だけ黒い…{n}違う岩石なのかもしれない。
en: Only this rock face is black... It could be a different kind of stone.

jp: 工房で練磨してもらえば{n}武器に使えるかもしれないな。
en: If a workshop refined it, it might be usable for a weapon.

jp: おや、この岩壁…
en: Well now, this rock wall...

jp: やっぱり黒曜石だわ。{n}商人に売ればお金になるわね。
en: It's obsidian, just as I thought. It'll bring good money from a merchant.

jp: グラムブレイズ
en: Gram Blaze

jp: 山賊団
en: Bandit

jp: セリカ遊撃隊
en: Cerica Troop

jp: {voice:00FB01}どうして届かないのよ……{n}セリカの想いが足りないせい③
en: Why can't Cerica reach you... Is Cerica's love not enough!?

jp: {voice:00FC01}敵討ちは諦めた方がいい。{n}あれは、不幸の連鎖しか{n}生み出さない。
en: You'd better give up on revenge. It only breeds a chain of misery.

jp: {voice:00FD01}黙れよ！　アンタらにセリカの{n}気持ちがわかってたまるかよー！
en: Shut up! Like any of you could ever understand how Cerica feels!

jp: {voice:00FE01}セリカ…、あなた。
en: Cerica... you...

jp: {voice:00FF01}何の騒ぎだ？
en: What is all this commotion?

jp: {voice:000002}双剣の旗印……{n}ソルティエ帝の直属軍だ！
en: The twin-sword banner... That's Emperor Soltier's own army!

jp: {voice:000102}あぁーッ、邪魔が入ったか！{n}今日のところは、引き上げるよ！
en: Aaagh, somebody butted in! Cerica's pulling out for today!

jp: {voice:000202}ガーロット！{n}その首、必ず貰ってやるからね！
en: Garlot! Cerica's taking your head, count on it!

jp: {voice:000302}ソルティエ帝、{n}魔竜と契約をした、{n}この国の頂点に立つ皇帝。
en: Emperor Soltier. He made a pact with a demon dragon, and he sits at the top of this country.

jp: {voice:000402}魔竜、ふーん…、{n}どうりで悪人面だと思った。
en: A demon dragon, huh... No wonder he's got that villain's face.

jp: {voice:000502}しっ！{n}シスキア、聞こえるぞ。
en: Shh! Siskier, he'll hear you.

jp: {voice:000602}おお、ヴェルマンか。{n}どうした、争う音がしたが？
en: Ah, Velleman. What is it? We heard fighting.

jp: {voice:000702}はっ、陛下。{n}野盗共が現れました故。
en: Yes, Your Majesty. Some bandits appeared.

jp: {voice:000802}なるほどな。{n}ところで、これは貴様の私兵か？
en: I see. And by the way, is this your private army?

jp: {voice:000902}さようでございます。{n}近頃はこのように街道にも賊が{n}現れますので。
en: That it is. Bandits have been appearing even on the highways of late, as you can see.

jp: {voice:000A02}見たところ、{n}そこの赤髪が大将とみえる。{n}名はなんと言う？
en: By the look of it, that redhead there is the leader. What is your name?

jp: {voice:000B02}……先に名乗るのが、{n}礼儀というものじゃないのか？
en: ...Isn't it good manners to give your own name first?

jp: {voice:000C02}貴様！{n}陛下になんという口をッ②
en: You! How dare you speak so to His Majesty!

jp: {voice:000D02}よい、ラピス。{n}育ちの悪さが出ているだけだ。
en: Enough, Lapis. It is merely his bad upbringing showing.

jp: {voice:000E02}なんだと！
en: What did you say!

jp: {voice:000F02}どうせ賊上がりの男だろう。{n}名乗らぬなら、あえて問いただす{n}事もない。
en: A former bandit, no doubt. If he will not give his name, We need not press the question.

jp: {voice:001002}もうよい。{n}さがれ、ヴェルマン。{n}俺は西部の巡察で忙しいのだ。
en: Enough. Withdraw, Velleman. We are busy with Our inspection of the west.

jp: {voice:001102}ちょっとちょっと！
en: Hey, wait just a minute!

jp: {voice:001202}ははっ、仰せのままに。
en: Yes, as you command.

jp: {voice:001302}ヴェルマン、何でよ！{n}あんな奴に頭下げることないわ！
en: Velleman, why!? You don't have to bow your head to a guy like that!

jp: {voice:001402}今、皇帝に逆らってどうなる？{n}何も変わらんどころか、{n}下手をすれば、即刻死罪だ。
en: And what if I defied the Emperor now? Nothing would change. At worst, an immediate death sentence.

jp: {voice:001502}お前達が{n}私を呼び捨てにするのとは{n}次元が違うのだ。
en: That is on another level entirely from you calling me by my bare name.

jp: {voice:001602}今はな、我慢の時だ。
en: For now, this is a time for patience.

jp: {voice:001702}ああ、もう！{n}これだから貴族って連中は！
en: Ugh, honestly! This is why I can't stand nobles!

jp: {voice:001802}気持ちはわかるが、{n}シスキア、ここは抑えろ。
en: I know how you feel, Siskier, but hold it in for now.

jp: {voice:001902}わかってるわよ！{n}でもね、納得いかないものは{n}納得いかないの！
en: I know that! But some things I just won't accept, okay!?

jp: {voice:001A02}全く、シスキアもガーロットも。{n}二人といると、夏でも涼しいよ。{n}きっと……
en: Honestly, Siskier and Garlot both. With you two around, I feel a chill even in summer. I'm sure of it...

jp: {voice:001B02}どういう意味だ、ジェノン。
en: What's that supposed to mean, Jenon?

jp: {voice:001C02}そのままだよ！
en: Just what it sounds like!

jp: もうよせ。{n}お前じゃ、俺達に勝てねぇよ。
en: Give it up. You can't beat us.

jp: うるさいっつーの！{n}セリカは、隊長の仇を討つって{n}決めたの！
en: Shut up already! Cerica made up her mind to get revenge for the captain!

jp: うーっ、ムカつく！{n}アンタさ、本当ムカつく！
en: Grrr, you piss Cerica off! You really, really piss Cerica off!

jp: しつこい女は嫌われるよ！
en: Nobody likes a clingy girl!

jp: まだまだ、{n}セリカはやれるよッ！
en: Not yet, Cerica's not done yet!

jp: 正直、女の子が相手だと、{n}調子が崩されるよ……
en: Honestly, fighting girls throws me off my game...

jp: そんな攻撃、{n}全然、堪えないんだから！
en: Attacks like that don't even hurt Cerica!

jp: タフだな、お前。
en: You're a tough one.

jp: こんなんじゃ物足りない…{n}ジワジワと、苦しませちゃう！
en: This isn't nearly enough... Cerica's gonna make you suffer, nice and slow!

jp: デイヴィド隊長の痛み、{n}思い知りな！
en: Now you'll know Captain David's pain!

jp: 許さない、許さない、{n}許さなーい！
en: Won't forgive you, won't forgive you, won't forgiiive you!

jp: なんだよ、これ……
en: What is this...

jp: ねぇなに～その大きな斧。{n}もしかして、飾りなわけー？
en: Hey, what's with that huge axe? Is it just for decoration or something?

jp: しつこい奴だな、お前も。
en: You just don't quit, do you.

jp: しつこくても構わない！{n}アンタを殺せば問題ナッシング！
en: Cerica doesn't care if she's stubborn! Once you're dead, no problemo!

jp: ムカつくのよ、アンタ！{n}男に媚び売ってバカじゃないの③
en: You piss Cerica off! Sucking up to guys, are you stupid!?

jp: アンタには言われたくないわよ！{n}何様のつもり③
en: Look who's talking! Who do you think you are!?

jp: お？　確かアンタも{n}ガーロットの仲間よね！{n}だったらマッサツよ②
en: Oh? You're one of Garlot's friends, aren't you! Then you're getting wiped out!

jp: 女の子と戦うのは{n}あんまり気が進まないなぁ…
en: I'm not too keen on fighting girls, you know...

jp: 無視すんなー②
en: Don't ignore Cerica!

jp: 相変わらずデカい斧ね…
en: That's still one huge axe...

jp: …い、いいもん！{n}勝負は大きさじゃない、{n}中身よ！　そして技術と技量よ！
en: ...F-fine! It's not size that counts, it's what's inside! And skill and technique!

jp: あんなにデカいんだから、{n}肩凝るに決まってるわ。{n}ええ、きっとそうに違いない！
en: Something that huge has gotta give you stiff shoulders. Yeah, it's gotta, it just has to!

jp: というわけで、セリカの結論！
en: So here's Cerica's conclusion!

jp: デカいモンぶら下げてっからって、{n}あんまり調子に乗んな～②
en: Don't get so full of yourself just 'cause you've got something big hanging there!

jp: …お前、何に怒ってるんだ？
en: ...What are you so angry about?
